('artifact_status','internal working artifact; ready for independent review'),
('owner','Head of Underwriting & AI Risk'),
('persona_audience','internal'),
('updated_at','2026-08-30'),
('source_workbook_sha256','ac5874683224bf09ffe0ad4b169ee6c8025df12132d4b0369e1954747edf66b8'),

check=load_workbook(out,data_only=False)
assert check['Event Mapping']['A5'].value.startswith('T1 —')
assert check['Event Mapping']['A10'].value.startswith('T6 —')

print('sheets=',check.sheetnames)
print('event_rows=',[(check['Event Mapping'].cell(r,1).value,check['Event Mapping'].cell(r,2).value) for r in range(5,11)])
